  Scenario: AC16 Call without a valid session is refused with 401 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the call carries no valid session
    When an unauthenticated caller calls GET /cases/{caseId}/timeline for case "RW-2026-000123"
    Then the response is 401 and no timeline is returned
    Then the read writes nothing

  Scenario: AC17 Retried or timed-out entry step (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the entry step for "A-0004" times out before its transaction commits
    When the entry step is retried in the next run
    Then the timed-out transaction is rolled back and no partial case exists for "A-0004"
    Then "A-0004" gets one case and exactly one decision record
    Then a retry that finds the case already created adds no second case
